title: Rotate List
description:
Given the head of a linked list, rotate the list to the right by k places. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/13/rotate1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,2,3,4,5], k = 2

Output:
 [4,5,1,2,3]
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/13/roate2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [0,1,2], k = 4

Output:
 [2,0,1]
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 500] . 
 
 -100 <= Node.val <= 100 
 
 0 <= k <= 2 * 10 9
